findings.evidence: Symmetry.lean:101-109 uses only `hx.mem_rootSpace α`, `hx.mem_rootSpace (-α)` and `hx.lie_neg α hα`; the last is what pulls in the full `IsSl2System`. Mathlib already has the ingredients for the general statement but no named lemma for it: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Killing.lean:129` (`mem_ker_killingForm_of_mem_rootSpace_of_forall_rootSpace_neg`), `:168` (`ker_killingForm_eq_bot`), `:608` (`finrank_rootSpace_eq_one`), `:632` (`toSubmodule_rootSpace_eq_span`); the same `∃ f ∈ rootSpace H (-α), killingForm K L e f ≠ 0` step is inlined ad hoc at `:279` and `:558`.
findings.fix: State the general form and drop the specialised one (callers pass `hx.mem_rootSpace α`/`hx.ne_zero α hα`): `theorem killingForm_ne_zero_of_mem_rootSpace {α : Weight K H L} (hα : α.IsNonZero) {e f : L} (he : e ∈ rootSpace H α) (he₀ : e ≠ 0) (hf : f ∈ rootSpace H (-α)) (hf₀ : f ≠ 0) : killingForm K L e f ≠ 0`. Proof: if all of `rootSpace H (-α)` paired to zero with `e` then `e ∈ ker (killingForm K L) = ⊥` by `mem_ker_killingForm_of_mem_rootSpace_of_forall_rootSpace_neg` and `ker_killingForm_eq_bot`; pick `f'` with `killingForm K L e f' ≠ 0`, and `rootSpace H (-α) = K ∙ f` by `toSubmodule_rootSpace_eq_span (-α) hα.neg f hf₀ hf`, so `f' = t • f` and `killingForm K L e f ≠ 0`.
findings.issue: `killingForm_root_neg_ne_zero` requires `hx : IsSl2System x` (a normalisation condition on the whole root family) to conclude `killingForm K L (x α) (x (-α)) ≠ 0`. The normalisation is irrelevant: the pairing `L_α × L_{-α} → K` is nondegenerate and both spaces are lines, so any nonzero `e ∈ rootSpace H α` and nonzero `f ∈ rootSpace H (-α)` pair nontrivially. The docstring ("in a normalized root-vector system ... their bracket is the nonzero coroot") reinforces the wrong reason.

summary: Two of the three results sit at the natural level, but `killingForm_root_neg_ne_zero` is stated under the global `IsSl2System x` hypothesis when the fact holds for any pair of nonzero root vectors in opposite root spaces.
